verdict.rationale: Bolt documents connecting GitHub to back up a project with a full change history that lives outside Bolt, and creating a new repository from a Bolt project. That gives users a real exit path for their code, in standard Git and npm/Node project formats. Nothing in the evidence covers exporting the rest of a user's data, such as Bolt Database contents, chat or prompt history, or hosting configuration. Missing for 10: documented export of Bolt Database data, export of chat/prompt history and project settings, an explicit full-account data export in open formats, and independent hands-on corroboration of a clean exit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
